Take the data, check it, add to it

Every page on this site is generated from YAML records in the repository. The same records project into tables, a graph, a wiki, the paper, and this site, and a validator keeps them consistent.

commands

from the repository root
git clone https://github.com/yoheinakajima/simgrammarget the repository
pip install -r requirements.txtpinned dependencies
make checkvalidate every rule and confirm every projection is fresh
python scripts/find.py production chainsearch before you create a record
python scripts/new.py run my-run --kind catalogopen a run before you edit data
make buildregenerate dist/, including this site
make sqlitequery everything with SQL

vocabularies

closed; add terms through an ADR
actor

Who performed a research run.

3 terms
agency_model

How player intent reaches the simulation. A game may use several.

11 terms
agent_count_order

Order of magnitude of individually simulated agents in typical play. Aggregate populations shown as a number but simulated as stocks count as `aggregate`.

7 terms
confidence

Confidence in a specific claim.

3 terms
determinism_impact

Effect on reproducibility, replays, lockstep multiplayer, and save integrity when used at runtime.

3 terms
edge_types

Every typed relation in the graph. Each edge is stored exactly once, on the `owner` side named here. Inverses are computed by the build and never stored. Symmetric edges are stored on the entity whose id sorts first.

13 terms
effect

How a technique changes a mechanic (attribute of the technique→mechanic `affects` edge).

7 terms
failure_model

What happens when the system goes wrong.

5 terms
feedback

Dominant feedback loop polarity the mechanic creates in play.

4 terms
fidelity

How closely the model tracks real-world causal structure. Independent of graphics.

5 terms
horizon

Expected time until meaningful use in shipped simulation games, as judged at the entity's last review date.

4 terms
math_basis

Formal mathematical model a mechanic instantiates, explicitly or implicitly. Used to connect mechanics to research literature.

24 terms
maturity

Adoption maturity of a mechanic across shipped games.

4 terms
mechanic_family

Primary functional family of a mechanic. Exactly one per mechanic. Assign by the state the mechanic owns, not by the genre it appears in.

21 terms
mechanic_role

Role a mechanic plays in a specific game (attribute of the game→mechanic `uses` edge).

2 terms
modding

Depth of player modification supported or widely practiced.

4 terms
multiplayer

Supported social play modes.

5 terms
narrative_mode

Where story comes from.

5 terms
opportunity_type

Kind of opportunity.

8 terms
perspective

Primary camera or presentation.

7 terms
platform

Platform families a game shipped on at any point.

8 terms
player_interface

How the player touches this mechanic.

9 terms
player_role

The fiction-level role the player occupies relative to the simulation.

13 terms
production_tier

Production context at release.

5 terms
risk

Primary risks of using a technique in simulation games.

11 terms
runtime

Where in the lifecycle the technique runs.

5 terms
sim_domain

Real-world domain the simulation models. One to three per game.

15 terms
sim_scale

Spatial or organizational scale of the primary simulated unit of play.

10 terms
source_kind

Type of cited source.

11 terms
status

Epistemic status of an entity. Ordered from weakest to strongest support. Status is a claim about evidence, never about importance.

4 terms
subgenre

Design lineage a game belongs to. One primary per game, optional secondaries. Lineage, not marketing label.

31 terms
substrate

Computational representation the mechanic is usually implemented on. A mechanic may have several.

10 terms
technique_category

Research area of a technique or breakthrough.

17 terms
technique_maturity

Deployment maturity of a technique in games specifically (not in general AI).

4 terms
time_model

Dominant relation between simulation time and player time.

6 terms
win_structure

How play is bounded and evaluated.

7 terms
